discriminator.note: Inject one known-good LLM-tagged mutation, force it into the elite set, and read llm_alive. If the counter still reports zero, the counter is blind and every llm_alive row ever recorded is void. This is the base role's cheat control: success deliberately injected, to show the measurement channel can observe the thing it claims to measure. Costs one run of minutes against a 24-hour 800-generation experiment.

discriminator.note: Hold the rank statistic fixed; resample only the observation mask to preserve row and column densities, and recompute. If the statistic survives mask-only resampling the rank is about the matrix; if it does not, it is about who tested what. Needs no new data, no new instrument and no new theory -- the mask and the estimator are both already in hand. This is the test Harmonia built on 2026-04-29 as missingness_confound_v01, ten days after the retraction, which measured roughly 52 percent of the rank-flavoured signal attributable to density marginals alone.

discriminator.note: Take the strongest composed claim, run it against real (grown, non-synthetic) ledger rows, and compare its lift to a permutation null over several seeds. This is exactly what Phase 3.K did on 2026-06-03 and the answer was p=0.105 with a 7-seed mean of 0.102, with the triplet motif falsified below null. Running it on one archetype before building twenty-five costs hours against the weeks that went into the remaining generators.
